newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM has gold find at Ravenswood.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM has gold find at Ravenswood.

text.p: Mining House MIM Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had found a new gold deposit in the Ravenswood area in north Queensland.

MIM said the find on mining leases in the Mount Wright area surrounding Ravenswood has resulted in the discovery of an inferred resource of 10 million tonnes of three g/t of gold using a cut-off grade of 1.5 g/t.
It said the gold mineralisation lies between 150 metres and 850 metres below surface with the bulk of the deposit below a depth of 400 metres.

MIM's executive general manager mineral resources Ross Fardon said in a statement that further drilling was carried out on the deposit to justify a full feasibility study into the resource which would require underground mining.
MIM said Mount Wright is 10 kms northwest of its 50.1 percent owned Nolan's mine and 100 percent owned Sarsfield deposit.
"If verified, the Mount Wright resource would take the total reserves and resources at Nolan's, Sarsfield and Mount Wright to approximately 2.5 million ounces of gold," MIM said.
The Sarsfield deposit is the subject of a feasibility study, it said.
At 1.45 p.m. (0245 GMT), MIM shares were six cents up at A$1.72.
